rankingGate.note: Discovery completeness means configured public sources reconciled all known date-scoped HBT forecasts; it is not a claim of universal world-football coverage.

priceLayer.note: Prices annotate model calls after prediction. They do not alter HBT probabilities, simulation or R1 experiment eligibility.

testAReference.name: Live Experiment — PRE-XI Test A
testAReference.note: Reference only. Ranking does not alter, remove, replace, or retrospectively optimise Test A.

experimentalValueVsPrice.reason: Compatibility status only. Price remains a downstream sidecar and cannot create, remove or reorder HBT football calls.

priceAssessment.reason: Bookmaker price is reported downstream for money/value/CLV analysis. It does not decide what HBT thinks will happen or whether a model-supported R1 test is eligible.

unsupportedOrIgnored.reason: Not silently dropped; full discovered fixture rows and exclusion reasons remain in the scanner output.
